Ajit Doval, National Security Advisor, was conferred with the prestigious Lokmanya Tilak National Award 2026 in Pune.

2. वर्षा अशोक अगलावे ने भारतीय भूवैज्ञानिक सर्वेक्षण (GSI) के 54वें महानिदेशक के रूप में कार्यभार संभाला और संगठन के 176 वर्ष के इतिहास में पहली महिला प्रमुख बनीं।

Soman Rana won the gold medal in the men's F57 Shot Put event at the Glasgow Commonwealth Games 2026.

Vice Admiral AN Pramod assumed charge as the new Deputy Chief of Naval Staff of India.

10. प्रसिद्ध भारतीय वायलिन वादक एल. सुब्रमण्यम को शास्त्रीय संगीत में उनके योगदान के लिए श्रीलंका के सर्वोच्च राजकीय सम्मान से सम्मानित किया गया।
Renowned Indian violinist L. Subramaniam was conferred with Sri Lanka's highest state honour for his contribution to classical music.

11. प्रीति पवार ने ग्लासगो राष्ट्रमंडल खेल 2026 में महिलाओं के 54 किग्रा मुक्केबाजी वर्ग में स्वर्ण पदक जीता।
Preeti Pawar won the gold medal in the women's 54kg boxing category at the Glasgow Commonwealth Games 2026.

12. सचिन सिवाच ने ग्लासगो राष्ट्रमंडल खेल 2026 में पुरुषों के 60 किग्रा मुक्केबाजी वर्ग में भारत के लिए स्वर्ण पदक जीता।

Praveen Chithravel won the silver medal in the men's triple jump event at the Glasgow Commonwealth Games 2026.

14. भारत और चीन के बीच छह वर्ष बाद सीमा व्यापार सिक्किम के नाथू ला दर्रे के माध्यम से पुनः शुरू हुआ।
Border trade between India and China resumed after six years through the Nathula Pass in Sikkim.

╭─❀⊰╯✍️ विश्व पर आधारित महत्वपूर्ण प्रश्न सीरीज
╨──────────────────━❥

प्रश्न 𝟏: संयुक्त राष्ट्र संघ (UNO) का मुख्यालय कहाँ स्थित है?
उत्तर: न्यूयॉर्क, अमेरिका

प्रश्न 𝟐: नोबेल पुरस्कार प्रदान करने वाला देश कौन सा है?
उत्तर: स्वीडन (शांति पुरस्कार को छोड़कर, जिसे नॉर्वे प्रदान करता है)

प्रश्न 𝟑: ‘ग्रेट बैरियर रीफ’ किस देश के तट के पास स्थित है?
उत्तर: ऑस्ट्रेलिया

प्रश्न 𝟒: प्रथम विश्व युद्ध किस वर्ष शुरू हुआ था?
उत्तर: 1914

#Citizenship

The Citizenship Act of 1955 prescribes five ways of acquiring citizenship, viz, birth, descent, registration, naturalisation and incorporation of territory: 

🔺️ BY BIRTH

🔸️ A person born in India on or after January 26, 1950 but before July 1, 1987 is a citizen of India by birth irrespective of the nationality of his  parents. 

🔸️ A person born in India on or after July 1, 1987 is considered as a citizen of India only if either of his parents is a citizen of India at the time of his birth. 

🔸️ Further, those born in India on or after December 3, 2004 are considered citizens of India only if both of their parents are citizens of  India or one of whose parents is a citizen of India and the other is not an  illegal migrant at the time of their birth.
 
🔸️ The children of foreign diplomats posted in India and enemy aliens  cannot acquire Indian citizenship by birth.

* जगजीवन राम — श्रम एवं पुनर्वास मंत्री
* रफी अहमद किदवई — संचार मंत्री
* सी. राजगोपालाचारी — सूचना एवं प्रसारण मंत्री
* डॉ बी आर अम्बेडकर — कानून मंत्री
* सरदार सुरजीत सिंह — रेल मंत्री

📌 INTEGRATION OF PRINCELY STATE.

#Unionanditsterritories

🔸️ At the time of independence, India comprised two categories of political units, namely, the British provinces (under the direct rule of British government) and the princely states (under the rule of native princes but subject to the paramountcy of the British Crown). 

🔸️ The Indian Independence Act (1947) created two independent and separate dominions of India and Pakistan and gave three options to the princely states which are :-

• joining India, joining Pakistan or remaining independent. 

🔸️ Of the 552 princely states situated within the geographical boundaries of India, 549 joined India and the remaining 3 (Hyderabad, Junagarh and Kashmir) refused to join India.

🔸️ However, in course of time, they were also integrated with India–Hyderabad by means of police action, Junagarh by means of referendum and Kashmir by the Instrument of Accession.
